one_month_reasoning: Effective start $98.43 (Twelve Data intraday 2026-10-21 after the Q3 print, -3.9% vs the $102.45 close; it traded as low as $97.74). The print and the Nutrition spin announcement are in the price: adjusted EPS $1.42 in line, FY26 EPS tightened to $5.50-5.55, FY26 comparable growth cut to ~6.0% from 6.5-7.5%, CGM guided low-to-mid single digit. Inside the window to 2026-11-19: the Q3 10-Q (post-Exact balance sheet, NEC docket count), the Oct 27-28 FOMC, the Nov 16 dividend, possible FDA/Libre or NEC trial news; the Libre Duo U.S. launch (December), the December FOMC and Q4 results with the 2027 guide (January) fall outside. Short-horizon regularities pull both ways: post-guidance-cut drift is mildly negative, while the stock sits near the bottom of its range after a ~25% drawdown. So I centre the month at ~$98.2 with the usual monthly vol (27%/3.5 = 7.7%) plus a 10% fat-tail component (14%); P(>= $98.35) 0.49, P(>= $102.45) 0.30.

comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No longer leaning on ABT's own 2016-2025 22.75x average (the peer group has de-rated; BSX 13.5x, MDT 15.4x). Two independent cross-checks: (a) segment-weighted peer P/E: FY28 segment profit Devices 59% at ~16x (device median 15.4x, ABT devices EPS growth ~7% vs peer median 7.3%), Diagnostics 18% at ~19x (between GEHC 13.7x and DHR 25.3x), Nutrition 11% at ~15x and EPD 12% at ~13x (judgment, staples/EM generics) = 16.1x; (b) 18.8x whole-company median less ~10% = 16.9x. The ~10% discount is persistent through the horizon: ~23% of segment profit is Nutrition + EPD (staples/generics multiples) until the spin, CGM growth has slowed to low-to-mid single digit with Medicare competitive bidding contracts awarded in 2027, ~12,700 NEC claims remain, and leverage is ~2x EBITDA after Exact.

thesis_break_reason: $78 is ~12x my NTM EPS (~$6.45) at the horizon, below the $81.97 52-week low, ~21% under today's $98.43 and at my bear scenario ($77). reasoning: Base rates first. ABT's own history (Twelve Data monthly closes 2013-2026): median 12-month price return +13%; after a trailing 12-month return <= -15% the next 12 months returned a median +12% (10 of 11 up); after drawdowns >= 20% from a 12-month high, a median +2% (13 cases). Spin-off base rates: median 9 months announcement-to-completion (Houlihan Lokey, 2019-22), but Abbott guides 'by end of 2027' and closed AbbVie exactly at its guided date, so I give ~10% to the Nutrition spin completing before 2027-10-20 (quote ~$7.5 lower, value-neutral). Prediction markets: Polymarket's December 2026 Fed hike (77.5c, ~$0.95M volume) argues against a quick re-rating; the end-2027 recession contract (~$11.7k volume) is too thin and enters only as a low-confidence bear note. Revision: the supervisor showed my 18x leaned on a peer median inflated by RMD and on ABT's own pre-de-rating history; with RMD out the 11-peer median is 18.8x and a segment-weighted peer P/E is 16.1x, so I use 17x. The CEO's 2027 framing (sales growth 'pretty similar', CGM low-to-mid single digit) cuts my Devices growth to 6.4%/6.2%, giving EPS ~$5.99/$6.57 (1.5-2.5% under consensus). Settlement cash ($670M NEC, $384M DOJ) is itemized in FY26 other uses; Libre 3 claims add -$150M expected; Medicare CGM bidding and other post-horizon risks are priced in the multiple and growth. Fair value $106.23 (P/E $108.51, EV/EBITDA $102.94, SOTP $102.62). Ladder: start $98.43; blend of the model scenario mix (bear $77.0 / base $106.2 / bull $134.3 at 25/50/25, within-scenario vol 15%) at 40%, a market-anchored lognormal (median ~$102.8, ~4.5% price drift, vol 25%) at 52% and an 8% fat tail (vol 45%), all with the 10% spin branch; median ~$103, P(>= $102) 0.52, P(>= $123) 0.25, P(< $82) 0.20. [citation gate 2026-10-21: Libre 3 claims -$220M x 0.5 = -$110M (midpoint of its own $0.17-0.27B after-tax range; was -$300M x 0.5); engine base $106.26 (P/E $108.53, EV/EBITDA $102.96, SOTP $102.65; was $106.23).
